_note: push/393: the solo chart grind (RUL-2026-10-31-088), two HIDDEN Battle Pyramids (push/394 unhides), Ghostwatch (level 80) and Faded Ghostwatch (level 30). Free entry, isolated, 100 attempts (engine cap), 5 scaled fights, the Wreck's chart table lowered. Icon is the Low Tide Run's (placeholder). Win rate unmeasured. Generated by push/skyglass_solo.gen.py; do not hand-edit.

data.name: Ghostwatch
data.description:
Five fights in a row. Health and chakra carry from fight to fight, and a lost fight ends the run. Free to enter; each clear rolls the Wreck's chart drops.

The Ghost Ship lies broken on the shore, and its crew still stand their watch. You go in alone, through the split keel, and climb the decks to the helm.

For level 80 and up. Drops the Skyglass Wreck's charts and Core Rot.
data.successDescription: You cleared the decks. The Core will have them back by morning.

objectives.description: The hull has split along the keel, and the gap is wide enough to climb through. Inside, the Core holds the deck the way it was: dry, lamplit, ready for sea. The watch has not been relieved in decades. It is not about to be relieved by you.
A Deck Warden calls the alarm. A seal charge is already rolling.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the Core pushes you out.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hull closes behind you.

objectives.description: The gun deck is quiet. The Sentinel at the stair has not moved in years, and the skyglass has grown over its feet. The First Blade sits on a powder keg beside it, waiting for anything new.
The skyglass cracks as the Sentinel steps free. The First Blade stands.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the Core pushes you out.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hull closes behind you.

objectives.description: The hold smells of tar and rot. An Oathkeeper stands guard over the stores, reciting the ship's articles to a Deck Warden who long ago stopped listening.
The Oathkeeper stops mid-article. "Boarders," he says, as if he has been hoping.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the Core pushes you out.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hull closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Core chamber hums. Something has steeped in the cracked crystal so long that it has grown a shape, and the shape has noticed you.
The Core spits out what it has been growing.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the Core pushes you out.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hull closes behind you.

objectives.description: The last stair opens onto the helm. The Arsenal Keeper has loaded every gun aft, and a Deck Warden holds the wheel on a heading nobody has changed in decades.
The Arsenal Keeper turns the guns inboard.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the Core pushes you out.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hull closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The wheel spins free. For a moment the whole ship seems to breathe out. Then the Core pulls the deck back the way it was, and the watch begins again.

You climb down through the keel with what you took.
You wake on the sand below the wreck with nothing to show for it. Above you, the watch goes on.
